# BLOG · changelogtriggers-shopinfos · y1quun

**Outcome.** infra class — reported, no MR

**Root cause.** changelogTriggers-shopInfos is generated by firestore-bigquery-changelog's registerV2 with no memory option, so it deployed at the firebase-functions v2 default of 256 MiB while loading this repo's src/index.js import graph needs 345 MiB — the container was OOM-killed during module load, never bound :8080, and the CreateFunction call failed with Container Healthcheck failed.

**Mechanism.** packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:8 calls changelog.registerV2({collections:[{shops},{shopInfos},{subscriptions}]}) passing no memory field, and packages/functions/src/globalOptions.js:5 sets only region + VPC, so no memory is declared anywhere in the chain and firebase-functions/v2 falls back to 256 MiB. The deployed spec in the CreateInternalService audit log confirms it: containers[0].name="worker", resources.limits.memory="256Mi", startupProbe tcpSocket:8080 failureThreshold:1 timeoutSeconds:240. packages/functions/src/index.js:12 exports changelogTriggers from the same index.js that re-exports http/pubsub/scheduled/firestore (koa, shopify, langchain/langgraph, ioredis, googleapis), so the container must evaluate the whole graph before the functions framework can listen. Instance 00a41e8c1d59dff22a1b0da2ff8086… on revision changelogtriggers-shopinfos-00001-civ logged "Memory limit of 256 MiB exceeded with 345 MiB used" at 2026-08-18T08:25:27.588168Z and, 0.399 ms later on the same instanceId, "Default STARTUP TCP probe failed 1 time consecutively for container \"worker\" on port 8080. The instance was not started. Connection failed with status CANCELLED." at 08:25:27.588567Z — the alerted probe failure is the consequence of the OOM kill, not a platform startup stall. Cloud Run then flipped Ready=False with reason HealthCheckContainerError at 08:25:28.342795Z, and CreateFunction (principal tuannv@avadagroup.com) returned status code 3 at 08:25:32.968948768Z. Revision 00001 means this was the function's first-ever deploy, so changelogTriggers-shopInfos does not exist in prod and no `shopInfos` changelog rows reach BigQuery. Contrast: the hand-written Firestore triggers in packages/functions/src/functions/firestore.js all declare memory:'512MiB' and deployed fine in the same run.

Confidence: `high` · infra class, not auto-fixed

## Code
- `packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:8` — registerV2({collections:[...]}) passes no memory/cpu option, so the three generated gen2 triggers take the firebase-functions v2 default of 256 MiB
- `packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:11` — the `shopInfos` collection entry — the specific trigger in this alert
- `packages/functions/src/globalOptions.js:5` — setGlobalOptions declares only region and VPC — no global memory floor, so nothing rescues a function that declares none
- `packages/functions/src/index.js:12` — changelogTriggers is exported from the same index.js that re-exports http/pubsub/scheduled/firestore, so each changelogtriggers-* container loads the full 345 MiB import graph before binding :8080
- `packages/functions/src/functions/firestore.js:36` — the hand-written trigger declares memory:'512MiB' and deployed successfully in the same run — the tier the changelog triggers should match
